messages:
alex: quick sketch — thinking about a new cost dashboard tile that shows token-level burn + cache-savings per model and per-route. Goal: make it easy for PMs to see "who" is driving token spend and what prefetched cache is saving us. want thoughts on routing/quota UX before i mock up the console.

maria: +1 on model+route split. question: how do we credit shared prefetch cache? per-invocation? session-level amortization?

sam: per-invocation feels noisy. i'd prefer session-amortized credits (spread savings across invocations in same session). we should expose both but default to amortized with sampling controls.

jia: telemetry angle — full token-level attribution is heavy. propose we sample 1% of invocations with full token traces and emit aggregated counters for the rest. also add a checkbox in the UI to toggle event-level view for admins.

alex: agreed. sampling + aggregated counters is the plan. for amortization i'd do: allocate prefetch savings proportionally by token_consumed_after_prefetch within session. sketch of algo:
```
for session in sessions:
  prefetch_savings = session.prefetch_cost_before - session.prefetch_cost_after
  for inv in session.invocations:
    inv.credit = prefetch_savings * (inv.tokens_after_prefetch / session.tokens_after_prefetch)
```

maria: that seems fair. edgecase: single long-running invocation in session will grab most credit — is that ok for UX?

sam: it's accurate but might surprise customers. UI should surface both raw and amortized numbers and a tooltip explaining the math. maybe call them "amortized cache savings (session)" and "raw per-invocation credit".

jia: another perf note: routing tags needed in telemetry so we can break down by routing policy (sticky vs cheap-route vs fallback). please ensure the trace includes route_id and model_variant.

alex: yep — route_id, route_policy, model_variant, sampled_tokens, and cache_hits will be in the payload. estimated overhead: +0.7% traffic size at 1% sampling, +5-8% if full traces enabled for admins.

sam: API debate: do we add a new /cost/attribution endpoint or extend /telemetry/events? i'd vote /cost/attribution to keep read-only dashboards separate and limit RBAC.

maria: +1 for separate endpoint. easier to throttle and version independently.

jia: for rollout UX — ship a beta with sampling default 0.5% and a console flag to opt-in to full traces. include a feature flag so we can toggle server-side.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/telemetry-cost-attrib -> staging at 2026-04-02T22:30Z (CI #4821) :rocket:

alex: thanks — i'll post a quick proto later today. would love short takes on the dashboard columns: [route, model_variant, invocations, tokens, cache_savings_amortized, cache_savings_raw, net_token_cost]. keep it tight.

maria: add a %savings column (savings / token_cost_before).

sam: and a small sparkline for tokens over time per route.

jia: logging note: include sampling_rate in the UI and in the exported CSV.

alex: perfect. will mock and upload — ping me if you want to play with the sample data generator.
